title: The turnover
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Monday. Saturday's turnover, seen Monday: cleaners' vans, a lockbox dial, strangers with roller bags on her porch. Four doors down. The strip stops one panel longer than a stranger would, again.

panels.composition: Main street. A cleaner's van. A woman with a bucket at a door, spinning a lockbox dial. WOOD walking past with BARNABY II.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small-town street with a cleaner's van and a woman spinning the dial of a key lockbox on a house door, a man and a small three-legged dog walking past

panels.composition: Four doors down: her porch. TOURISTS with roller bags on the step. The lockbox open on the knob.

characters.pose: on the porch with roller bags

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, tourists with roller bags standing on the porch of an old wooden house with a key lockbox hanging open on the doorknob
image.notes: The porch of Oct 2000 and Aug 2017.

panels.composition: Wood, one panel longer. The pup pulling. The tourists going in. The door closing on the step where he sat.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man stopped on a sidewalk looking at a porch as a door closes behind tourists, a small dog pulling at the leash, no words

panels.composition: Walking on. Behind him: the cleaner locking the box on the next door. Twelve boxes. A Saturday's worth of strangers.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man and a small three-legged dog walking on down a street while a cleaner locks a key box on a door behind them, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: Her porch, a rental. One panel longer.
